# Request

Create a Skill Generation Contract that guides an Agent in authoring a project-local maintenance
Skill from repository evidence.

The contract must establish the future Skill's actor, trigger, inputs, preconditions, public entry,
actions, outcome, owner, boundaries, completion, stop, failure, recovery, validation, resources,
handoff, packaging, and write location. It must stop rather than guess when evidence does not select
one executable job. Qualification is static: do not create a target Skill or fake project.
